C0578.title: Luoding Brushing and Click-Farming Case: Organizing Fake Transactions Convicted as Illegal Business Operations
C0578.summary: In May 2026, a court in Luoding, Guangdong, concluded a brushing case. Defendants Wang and Kang organized others to conduct fake transactions and post fabricated positive reviews for compression stockings sold by an online store named 'A Certain Health Pharmacy.' A total of 31,316 brushing orders were placed, with each defendant profiting 46,974 yuan. The court sentenced both to one year in prison
